title: ListedEnvironment

name.description: An environment's name as the client has it: 1 to 200 characters once trimmed, counted as code points, no control or format (zero-width) characters other than white space; kept trimmed with white space collapsed.

address.description: The address the client uses for the environment, as its connection keeps it: an http or https origin, http://host:port.

description: An environment of the union: its name and the address a client uses for it.
